title: [question] Is it possible to use this project without raylib?
body:
Hello! Cool project! There are not so many animation libs written in C.
I quickly looked through the code an noticed that the only thing has been used from raylib is "raymath". I want to use it in my future projects, but with more advanced graphics API (prob bgfx or wgpu). All I need to do is to replace math functions with "my own", right?
author: CortexReaver

comments.body:
Hi @CortexReaver, thanks for showing your interest in this project.

And yes the pose computation part only uses raymath for some simple Matrix and Transform related functions. Only raylib part is used for fetching pose or skeleton and applying the pose to model. All other middle transformations to the pose are independent of raylib(but need raymath).

> Helpful note: There are some optimizations required here and there and bad naming convention. And i personally prefer using `Pose` over `Skeleton` because it gives a lot of free space to work with animations but it is painful to manage memory with those.(You can see it in examples/pose directory).

Hope it'll help.
